content:
Marta: Quick thread to capture an alternative to escrow/consent: proposal = "stamped shadow-writes" + short owner lease. Aim: avoid frequent cross-region syncs while preserving owner-authoritative invariants.

Rohit: Summarize the stamp concept?

Marta: Each write gets a lightweight "stamp" signed by the local proxy: {tenant, provisional_id, local_region, stamp_epoch, signature}. If local region is not owner, proxy does a shadow-write locally (write+stamp) and concurrently attempts a fast lease-check against owner. Owner issues the canonical stamp when it accepts and returns canonical_id. Reconcile maps provisional -> canonical.

Lina: How is this different from optimistic provisional I/O? The stamp makes reconciliation deterministic if we include epoch and owner-ack. Also owner lease (short TTL) prevents split-brain: only region holding lease can issue canonical stamps.

Theo: Failure modes? If owner slow or unreachable, local shadow-writes allow progress for eventual-mode tenants; for owner-only tenants proxies must block.

Marta: Right. Policy modes: owner-only, eventual-stamped, owner-prefer. Proxies cache policy with per-tenant SLO overrides.

Rohit: DB invariants: owner mints global sequence numbers. During reconcile, if conflict on unique keys owner wins and reconciliation emits compensating deletes or patches. Stamps help correlate events.

Lina: Revocation and lease handoff: control-plane increments lease-epoch on owner change; proxies check epoch on lease-checks and drop local stamps when mismatch. We also push a lease-revoke event to edge proxies for quick eviction.

Marta: Headers and observability: forwarded header `X-RW-Stamp: region=eu;stamp=stmp-abc;epoch=42;mode=stamped`. Emit metrics: `residency.path` {stamped-local, forwarded, blocked}, `residency.reconcile_ms`, `residency.conflict_rate`.

Theo: Canary: enable stamped mode for non-PII tenants in single region pair. Track reconcile lag, conflict rate, and delta in user p95. Ops will abort if reconcile lag > 5s or conflict_rate > 0.1%.

Rohit: Owners: Marta -> sequence/lease design; Lina -> reconcile worker; Theo -> proxy integration + rollout gating; I'll add telemetry dashboards.

Marta: Nice. I'll write a short RFC addendum with sequence diagrams and a minimal proto for stamps. deploy-bot: sim artifacts -> https://ci.redwood/sims/stamped-shadow/3740000000
